verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe simulation endpoints for card network transaction events (authorizations, reversals, balance inquiries) in a sandbox that never touches a real network, plus a quick-start tutorial walking through creating card products/users/cards and simulating transactions before real swipes. Refunds/clearings/declines are implied via 'each endpoint is its own event type' but not individually enumerated in evidence. Missing for 10: explicit mention of clearing/refund/decline simulation endpoints by name, and independent/hands-on developer confirmation of full lifecycle coverage.
